description: Set up an opening alert in the person's own linked PermitSnag account, for ONE permit (give permit, startDate, endDate, partySize) or ONE campground (give campground, checkInStart, checkInEnd, nights, and optionally sitesNeeded). PermitSnag then sends the person an alert when a matching opening appears. Use the permit or campground id from search_permits or search_campgrounds. Starting areas, night-by-night plans and groups of trailheads are set up on the website instead. The same request sent twice sets up one alert. It never books, pays or enters a lottery. When the account needs a purchase for this alert, the answer may hold the alert and give payment links for the person to open and pay on a checkout page; the alert then turns on by itself once paid. Nothing is ever charged from this tool.

campground.description: The campground id. Give this or permit, not both.

checkInEnd.description: Campground alert: the last acceptable check-in day, YYYY-MM-DD.

checkInStart.description: Campground alert: the first acceptable check-in day, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Permit alert: the last day the person could start, YYYY-MM-DD.

nights.description: Campground alert: nights in a row.

permit.description: The permit id or slug. Give this or campground, not both.

sitesNeeded.description: Campground alert: sites needed together. Default 1.

startDate.description: Permit alert: the first day the person could start, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: create_alert

outputSchema.description: The alert set up, the one already set up for the same request, or the reason it was refused.

id.description: The alert id. Null only for an alert already set up whose id the website did not return.

holdId.description: awaiting_payment only: the held alert. It turns on by itself when one of paymentLinks is paid.

linksExpireAt.description: awaiting_payment only: when the payment links stop working.

pageUrl.description: The PermitSnag page for this place.

label.description: What the link buys, in words.

priceUsd.description: Price in US dollars. The checkout page may show the local currency.

purchase.description: What the link buys: this permit or campground once, or PermitSnag Pro.

url.description: Opens the checkout page for this purchase. The person pays there; nothing is charged from here.

reason.description: Why the request was refused, as a short code.

title: Set up a PermitSnag alert
